\`\`\`{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
run_id <- params$run_id
out_dir <- "reports/output"
read_run_csv <- function(prefix) {
  path <- file.path(out_dir, paste0(prefix, "_", run_id, ".csv"))
  if (file.exists(path)) utils::read.csv(path, stringsAsFactors = FALSE) else data.frame()
}
manifest <- read_run_csv("manifest")
stages <- read_run_csv("stages")
inventory <- read_run_csv("inventory")
\`\`\`

This report contains aggregate operational metadata only. It does not include patient-level records, note text, or row-level QC exceptions.

## Release overview

\`\`\`{r overview}
if (nrow(manifest)) knitr::kable(manifest) else cat("Manifest unavailable.")
\`\`\`

## Processing stages

\`\`\`{r stages}
if (nrow(stages)) knitr::kable(stages) else cat("Stage log unavailable.")
\`\`\`

## Stage details

### 01 — Mother–infant–delivery linkage

Canonical mother, infant, and delivery IDs are generated and validated. Cached site-specific linkage inputs are reused when available.

### 02 — Delivery encounters

GNV and JAX delivery encounters are processed and checked for infant-level uniqueness and nonmissing delivery IDs.

### 03 — Linkage validation

Deep linkage QC executes, including multiple-birth and delivery-episode reviews. Individual exceptions are intentionally excluded from this report.

### 04 — ICD diagnoses

Maternal and infant ICD processing scripts execute. The file inventory below records emitted datasets; row counts are not inferred from file size.

### 05 — Medications

Maternal inpatient and outpatient medication processing scripts execute.

### 06 — Clinical-note metadata

Maternal and infant note metadata processing executes; clinical note text is not included in this report.

### 07 — Release manifest

Inventory lists output file paths relative to the output root, byte sizes, and modification dates. This is an inventory, **not** proof that all datasets are fresh, complete, or synchronized. Dataset-level counts and QC metrics will require explicit aggregate exports from each stage.

## Output inventory

\`\`\`{r inventory}
if (nrow(inventory)) {
  knitr::kable(inventory)
} else cat("No output files found.")
\`\`\`

## Interpretation

Successful stage completion means the corresponding script returned without an error. It does not independently certify downstream data quality. Review stage-specific QC output before releasing data.
